gate: h15-autodetect-cert — Auto Detect (stroke auto-selection vs declared separation, ambiguous/practice-swing/miss/unsupported handling) + adaptive completion adequacy

method.harness: datasets/experiments/wave-h/h15-autodetect-cert.ts (deterministic, run via tsx from packages/swing-lab); full machine-readable results in datasets/experiments/wave-h/h15-cert-report.json
method.replay: All 29 committed stroke-gold labels replayed through the production AUTO route: classifyStroke (stroke-heuristic-6, uncalibrated) → resolvePredictedProfile ladder; 18 evaluable on Linux (committed pose exists only for the 8 wave-a corpus windows; afn-sasebo-rally1×7, afn-sasebo-rally2×2, wm-volley-02×2 unevaluable — no fabricated numbers). paddle=null everywhere (no committed paddle tracks). Grouped by corpus sessionKey, never by frame.
method.syntheticAdversarial: 10 deterministic synthetic pose cases (practice swing/no contact, whiff with estimated contact, static reach, walk-through, wheelchair rim propulsion, near-profile shoulders, transient torso collapse, midline-ambiguous contact, no reference, ambidextrous handedness) + 5 hostile-provider ladder predictions + 3 declared-slug resolution checks + declared-vs-predicted separation checks on every committed replay side read.
method.completion: D-029 constant parity verified across 4 copies (sessionEngine SESSION_COMPLETION, eventCompletionBench literals, mobile CAPTURE_COMPLETION_PARAMS_V1, native StrokeCompletionMonitor.swift); live SessionEventEngine synthetic closure runs (settle/valley/safety/flush) + append-only late-sample check; replay completion bench (pnpm --filter @pickle/swing-lab exec tsx src/eventCompletionBench.ts) on the 11 target-owner gold events with committed pose.
method.holdouts: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 never read or touched (absent from stroke-gold by construction; verified untouched).
method.limits: Linux CPU replay only — no iPhone/Mac measurements exist or are claimed. stroke-heuristic-6 confidences are uncalibrated heuristic floors, not calibrated probabilities.

leafCommits.note: single leaf commit is OVERHEAD on wavea-944403-smash, correct at conf 0.85

wrongDetail: wavea-faead-rally@13417: FOREHAND vs gold groundstroke/backhand, conf 0.60 (degraded: event-peak reference, no contact evidence — E10-F1 cap route)
wavea-wgm-wheelchair@182400: FOREHAND vs gold dink/backhand, conf 0.80 (seated/wheelchair player, gold contact)

declaredSeparation.note: Declared intent is never overwritten by the prediction; disagreement is surfaced exactly and only when structurally demonstrable.

syntheticAdversarial.note: Practice swing (no contact) and whiff (estimated contact, no paddle evidence) commit at most a depth-2 family side with disclosed limiting factors and produce result:null downstream (partialAutoRecord) — never a scored stroke Result. All 8 ambiguity/unsupported cases (static reach, walk-through, rim propulsion, near-profile, torso collapse, midline contact, no reference, ambidextrous) abstain outright.

hostileProviderLadder.note: Sub-floor confidence, unregistered leaf, unresolvable depth-2 label, and UNKNOWN leaf marker all abstain; a depth-2 side is never promoted to a leaf.

slugResolution.note: Ambiguous multi-canonical slug without canonical resolves to no profile; contradicting canonical is ignored, never trusted.

adaptiveCompletion.shippedDefaultStrategy: fixed (adaptive is an explicit runtime switch, shadow-instrumented, not promoted — matches D-043)

replayBenchTargetEvents.adaptiveEarlyStopDetail: wavea-wgm-wheelchair: adaptive closed 34ms before labeled recovery end (recoveryLost=1)
replayBenchTargetEvents.note: n=11 is the Linux-evaluable subset; the committed 20-event gate artifact is datasets/experiments/EXP-2026-08-28-adaptive-completion.json. Both support keeping FIXED as the shipped default: fixed loses nothing (0 early stops / 0 content lost), adaptive still has a replay-only early-stop risk.

measuredResults.rootGates: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check — all exit 0 on this branch (no production code changed; evidence + harness only).

p1.finding: Confident-wrong family-side reads on replay: of 3 committed side reads with gold-known side, 2 are wrong (wavea-faead-rally@13417 FOREHAND conf 0.60 vs gold backhand; wavea-wgm-wheelchair@182400 FOREHAND conf 0.80 vs gold backhand dink, seated player). Wrong reads span 2 of 3 session groups. These surface as an 'Auto-detected: Forehand (family)' style read with result:null — no scored Result, no fault/drill output, but the family tag itself is user-visible and wrong.
p1.whyNotFixedHere: Not internally solvable without violating wave rules: the only available levers are uncalibrated threshold surgery (raising the side-commit floor or making the degraded event-peak route abstain), which on this 18-label bench would be tuning denominators/thresholds to pass and would silently flip the locked mobile-reality wrist-fallback behavior (W4) that intentionally commits degraded sides at ≥0.525. Known LABEL_STARVED since Wave E (e03: candidate kept 3 confident-wrong); needs new gold labels (esp. seated/adaptive players and rotated-torso rallies) before any recalibration is honest.
p1.releaseImpact: Must be weighed by the release gate owner: family reads are precision-poor on side-known replay data (1/3 correct). Mitigations already shipped: depth-2 reads never produce a scored Result, limiting factors are disclosed on-device, declared intent is never overwritten.

p2.finding: Native StrokeCompletionMonitor has a disclosed reset-adjacent divergence vs the TS engine (detector clears wrist priors on reset; monitor uses only the 250ms gap gate). Shadow-only today since adaptive is not the shipped default.

11 of 29 stroke-gold labels are unevaluable on Linux (no committed pose for afn-sasebo-rally1/2, wm-volley-02), so replay certification covers 18 labels across 3 session groups; wheelchair/adaptive play is represented by a single label.

verdict.rationale: PASS on every safety-critical property this gate certifies: practice swings / whiffs / unsupported and ambiguous movements never produce a confident stroke Result (0 wrong leaf commits anywhere; 10/10 synthetic adversarial, 5/5 hostile-ladder, 3/3 slug checks pass); declared intent is fully separated from prediction (4/4 contradictions surfaced, 0 silent overwrites, 0 false alarms); adaptive completion is adequate as shipped (FIXED default loses no content on replay, 8/8 constant parity, all live-engine closure paths verified, append-only holds). NOT certified as accurate: the depth-2 family side read is confidently wrong on 2 of 3 gold-side-known replay commits (P1, unresolved-external, label-starved) — if the release bar requires accurate family auto-reads rather than safe ones, treat that single component as NO-GO until new gold labels allow honest recalibration.
